sources.entry: HazeOver - App that dims your background app windows so you can focus more on your main task! [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/ph/app/hazeover-distraction-dimmer/id430798174?platform=mac)

summary.name: HazeOver
summary.one_liner: HazeOver (Distraction Dimmer) is a Mac app that automatically dims background windows so the active window stands out.
use_cases: Focus on one window at a time
Find the active window across multiple monitors
Reduce glare and eye strain at night
Make screenshots or recordings look cleaner
Automate dimming with Focus modes or Shortcuts
summary.what_it_does: HazeOver automatically highlights the frontmost window or app by dimming background windows, so you don't need to minimize or hide them. Dimming intensity and animation speed are adjustable, and separate settings can be used for Dark and Light appearance. A keyboard shortcut or gesture toggles shading, and holding the Fn key temporarily turns dimming off while dragging between apps. It can be controlled through the Shortcuts app, Focus filters, and AppleScript.
notable: Dims background windows instead of requiring minimize or hide
Separate dimming settings for Dark and Light appearance
Automation via Shortcuts, Focus filters, and AppleScript
Listed on the Mac App Store
caveats: Requires macOS Ventura 13 or later, per the page
Some features depend on newer macOS versions (e.g., Shortcuts needs Monterey or later)
Pricing is not stated on the page
